mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (indicating monetary tightening) compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates applied to future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active during monetary tightening cycles and is always-on within that regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising (month-over-month), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals labor market deterioration and an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a negative S&P 500 return over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 250), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO falling below its 3-month prior value) signals a supply shock that disrupts economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < INDPRO_{t-3mo} AND CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS is rising (month-over-month), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500 (thousands) signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased corporate investment and lower discount rates for equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payrolls (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where both PAYEMS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
